Game Overview

In Baby Noob vs Baby Obby Horse, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a whimsical treasure hunt with two baby siblings through a perilous forest. Defend against beasts using bottles, collect hidden lollipops, and master the double jump across 12 captivating levels. Unravel mysteries while dodging danger in this charming, action-packed adventure.
